run_eval_model: run the eval_model function to compute FID scores for a trained flow matching model
create_CFGScaledModel: create a CFGScaledModel wrapper to apply classifier-free guidance scaling to a PyTorch model
generate_discrete_samples: generate synthetic image samples using discrete flow matching with the MixtureDiscreteEulerSolver
generate_continuous_samples: generate synthetic image samples using continuous ODE solving with the ODESolver
save_fid_samples: save generated FID evaluation samples as PNG images to an output directory
